entries.title: boot.log: a kidnapped workstation
entries.summary: How a work PC came home with me first, why I'm doing this at all, and the toolchain I set up in the two weeks before the jam.

entries.title: validate.sh: the night before, and a Director's Cut
entries.summary: One long day of testing everything twice, an agent that went one step too far, deleting it all, the kickoff stream and the theme.

entries.title: push_pull.md: inspiration, not a plan
entries.summary: There is no concept yet. There is a pile of directions pulling against each other, and me being overwhelmed at 3 AM, three hours before the start.

entries.title: day-1.log
entries.summary: From an empty folder at 06:00 to a packaged island with a castle, night, rain, NPCs, a title screen, a studio logo and a pile of review boards. Builds 0.0 to 0.6, and the first time it all got too much.

entries.title: day-2.log
entries.summary: Nine builds in 28 hours. The Mac gets dropped, Build 0 is called final, the masked guard learns to be suspicious, and the castle gets a silhouette. Also foam everywhere, flat LUTs, four editors open at once and far too many boards.

entries.title: day-3.log
entries.summary: Build 1 starts: an escort, a cell with two cellmates who talk back through NVIDIA ACE, a kit-built castle and end credits. Then two GPU driver hangs, a hard reboot, and a new way of working. Status so far, still running.

entries.title: post-mortem.log
entries.summary: After the deadline. What worked, what exploded, what I'd do again.

entries.title: builds.log
entries.summary: Every build of the jam so far, with the branches, features and fixes that went into it.
